blocks.label: Cinematography
blocks.body: Slow dolly in, medium shot on a 35mm.

blocks.label: Subject
blocks.body: A retired boxer taping his hands in a basement gym, basement gym at 6am, condensation on the windows.

blocks.label: Action
blocks.body: He finishes taping, flexes the fist, then looks up at the camera. Steam rising throughout.

blocks.label: Style & ambiance
blocks.body: Practical lamps only. Crushed blacks, high contrast grade. Tense in feeling, deliberate.

blocks.label: Audio
blocks.body: He says, "Last round." SFX: skipping rope on concrete. Ambient: distant traffic.

blocks.label: Reference
blocks.body: In the register of Roger Deakins night exteriors.

settings.name: resolution
settings.why: Requires mode std. Fast caps at 720p

notes: Budget the prompt across the timeline. A 30-second prompt describing only the opening image gives you five seconds of intent and twenty-five of hallucination.
Structure: subject, performance across the full duration, ambience, camera, then audio and continuity cues.
warnings: In video_edit mode duration and aspect_ratio are ignored and you are billed by source length. Passing them is a silent no-op.
4K and 1080p need mode std. Fast mode caps at 720p.
generate_audio is independent of audio_references. Set both deliberately.

variations.name: Colder, more documentary
variations.text: Swap the grade for desaturated earth tones, drop to available light only, and shoot it on a 35mm at f/2.8. Same subject, no styling.

variations.name: Tighter and more graphic
variations.text: Go to an extreme close-up on the single most telling detail. Hard directional light, deep shadow, generous negative space around it.

variations.name: Wider, with context
variations.text: Pull back to an establishing wide. Put the subject small in the frame and let the setting carry the story. Keep the same light and grade.
